contact.name: Martha Sedgwick
contact.designation: Sage senior vice president for innovation
contact.evidence_quote: As the practice of both teaching and conducting research continues to evolve, our aim is to provide the expert guidance and publishing innovations which will support researchers well into the future. The launch of Sage Campus is a major step towards this goal and we look forward to seeing the impact that the courses have on the development of future social science research. Martha Sedgwick, Sage senior vice president for innovation
